thread:
Maya: Noticed an oddity on the cost widgets this morning — route /chat/stream shows sustained warm_hit counts but the per-model unit-econ card reports near-zero cache credits for a 2 minute window. Anyone else see this?
Tom: I saw alerts for high warm_hit_ratio last night; curious the credits don't align. Which dashboard panel are you looking at?
Maya: The per-model unit-econ card (model: gpt-small-opt) + the route-level amortized-savings sparkline. Warm hit events in raw token_events look normal.
Diego: Could be the new "credit-collapse" step we shipped — it dedups transient lineage entries to reduce cardinality. If it collapses a burst into a single owner, we might be attributing credits elsewhere.
Lina: UX note: users interpret "amortized savings = 0" as meaning cache not used. We should avoid that ambiguity — maybe show an inline note when sampling or dedupe heuristics are active.
Maya: Agree. Also need to confirm whether this is data loss or misattribution.
Tom: Quick sanity check — I ran a fold query across raw events vs reconciler output. Query:
```
-- total warm tokens vs reconciler credits
SELECT sum(warm_tokens) as raw_warm, sum(credited_tokens) as reconciled
FROM token_events
WHERE event_ts BETWEEN 4920000600 AND 4920001200
AND route = '/chat/stream';
```
Result: raw_warm = 18,400 tokens, reconciled = 0 for the 2-minute window.
Diego: Zero reconciled implies the reconciler skipped emitting credits for that window. I pushed a small change yesterday that moves emission to a separate commit path — maybe a bug in the commit gating.
reconciler-bot: deploy 4920001105 - reconciler service v1.9 -> v1.10 (toggle: credit_collapse=true).
Priya: If the canary toggled collapse, it may have collapsed the entire burst away because sessions didn't settle. Two mitigations: (A) temporarily disable collapse for routes with warm_hit_rate > threshold, (B) emit provisional credits on batch close.
Diego: Option B sounds safe: emit provisional credits with a flag so downstream remains traceable; reconciler can later reconcile duplicates.
Lina: Dashboard UX: add a small banner on the unit-econ card when provisional credits are present, with a link to "why credits are provisional". Also surface the reconciler version used for the data window.
Maya: Ops: can we roll the reconcilerv1.10 flag back for production?
reconciler-bot: rollback 4920001120 - reconciler v1.10 -> v1.9 (auto-rollback triggered).
Tom: Good, rollback should stop further missing credits. Diego, can you add the provisional emit flag and ensure we label provisional credits in metrics?
Diego: Will do. I'll add an extra column credited_provisional=true on interim rows and set a TTL so reconciler dedupe can remove duplicates.
Priya: Also request a short-term alert: when warm_hits > 5k/min and reconciled_credits = 0 for > 30s, fire a SEV-3 to eng-platform.
Lina: For the console copy, I'll draft the informational tooltip and the "provisional" chip copy. We should include a quick explanation of why reconciler-level dedupe can temporarily suppress credits.
Maya: I'll open the infra ticket and link the console task. Priya, can you own the alert? Tom, can you run a synthetic burst against staging to confirm parity between raw events and reconciler outputs?
Tom: On it. I'll script a 3-minute ramp to 6k warm_hits/min against staging, capture token_events and reconciler emissions, and post the diff here.
Diego: Plan: 1) emit provisional credits immediately on batch close, 2) reconcile/dedupe later, 3) add metric labels credited_provisional and reconciler_version. I estimate a small patch + deploy in ~2 hours.
Maya: Thanks. Quick wins: rollback happened, alert requested, Diego implementing provisional emit, Lina drafting UX. We'll reconvene after staging test.
Priya: Posted the alert runbook in the incident playbooks doc and /assign to eng-platform on PagerDuty.
Maya: Closing for now — keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
